348:t_022:14.en:
$$万丈$$
「$$アサキム$$... I'll set our reckoning aside for now.」

348:t_022:15.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「...Your foolishness truly knows no bounds. You really are an inferior species.」

348:t_022:16.en:
$$万丈$$
「Here I come, $$サイデリアル$$! On this Mars, I swear to win!」

348:t_023:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Tch... I couldn't finish him off.」

348:t_023:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Running away, are you, $$バルビエル$$!」

348:t_023:2.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I'm not foolish enough to fight six $$スフィア$$s at once.」

348:t_024:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Tch... What an annoying bunch.」

348:t_024:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Running away, are you, $$バルビエル$$!」

348:t_024:2.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I'm not foolish enough to fight six $$スフィア$$s at once.」

348:t_026:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Don't chase him, $$アサキム$$. There's no need to rush a settlement here.」

348:t_027:0.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Wait, $$アサキム$$. There's something I want to ask you.」

348:t_027:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I have no more business here.」

348:t_027:2.en:
$$クロウ$$
「You really seem to have hated being sealed inside the $$ＺＯＮＥ$$.」

348:t_027:3.en:
$$アサキム$$
「...Not really. I thought that falling into an eternal sleep as we were would have been best for me and for you all.」

348:t_027:4.en:
$$アサキム$$
「But if I've been woken from that sleep, I'll struggle. Ugly, shameless... and graceless.」

348:t_028:0.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「...He does tend to be far too single-minded.」

348:t_028:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$... Did you free $$アサキム$$ from the $$ＺＯＮＥ$$?」

348:t_028:2.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「No. But there was a connection, and I ended up acting together with him.」

348:t_028:3.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Did you bring that man into the $$クロノ$$ Reformists?」

348:t_028:4.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「You are welcome to think so.」

348:t_028:6.en:
$$桂$$
「You should have died in the fight with $$ガドライト#pilot$$...」

348:t_028:7.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Does it displease you that I'm alive?」

348:t_028:9.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「We've fought someone who faked their death before.」

348:t_028:10.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「You mean the $$偽りの黒羊$$, $$アイム・ライアード$$... True, the reason I'm alive is probably something close to the power of his $$スフィア$$.」

348:t_028:12.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「No, Miss $$スズネ$$. I only ever speak the truth.」

348:t_028:13.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「$n... You understand that, don't you?」

348:t_028:15.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I apologize for not telling you I was alive. ...But you will believe me, won't you?」

348:t_028:17.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Look me in the eyes, $n.」

348:t_028:19.en:
$n
「More than anything, I'm just happy you're alive...」

348:t_029:0.en:
$$ブルー$$
「...My apologies, Captain. I lost sight of $$アサキム・ドーウィン$$.」

348:t_029:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Don't worry, $$ブルー$$. His path and mine lead to the same place, so sooner or later he will return to us.」

348:t_029:3.en:
$$ブルー$$
「It's been a while, $$クロウ$$. I had heard you went to $$蒼の地球$$, but you've joined up with $c.」

348:t_029:4.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Did you know that $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ was alive?」

348:t_029:5.en:
$$ブルー$$
「I apologize. At the time we made contact with you, even we did not yet know that fact.」

348:t_029:6.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「When we were about to be caught in $$アマルガム$$'s $$時空震動弾$$ at $$第２新東京市$$, you appeared, but...」

348:t_029:7.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「That was on my orders. I tried to suppress the spacequake, but the result is what you all know.」

348:t_029:9.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Wait, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$. We're not done talking yet.」

348:t_029:10.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I'm sorry, $$クロウ$$. There is still something I must do.」

348:t_029:11.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「But someday, I will fight alongside you. Because your path and mine lead to the same place.」

348:t_029:12.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Until we meet again, $n. I await the day you overcome hope and despair.」

348:t_030:1.en:
$$ノイン$$
「Including the existence of the $$クロノ$$ Reformists, everything is shrouded in mystery...」

348:t_030:2.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Even if you tell me to trust a guy like that...」

348:t_030:3.en:
$$マオ$$
「Knock it off, $$クルツ$$. Think about how $n feels.」

348:t_030:5.en:
$n
「No, it's all right... I haven't managed to process $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ being alive myself, either...」

348:t_030:6.en:
$n
「Of course, I'm glad he's alive, but...」

348:t_030:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Everyone... I'm sorry to interrupt, but a fleet is approaching us.」

348:t_031:0.en:
$$宗介$$
「The $$クォーター$$...! And the $$ラー・カイラム$$ and other ships are there too!」

348:t_031:1.en:
$$カレン$$
「That's not all! The $$真ゲッタードラゴン$$ is there too!」

348:t_031:2.en:
$$ブライト$$
「We came because $$ブルー$$ guided us, and...」

348:t_031:3.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「I never thought they'd be here too...」

348:t_031:5.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「So they, too, were tossed about by a great power, just as we were...」

348:t_031:6.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「...A message came in from $$アークセイバー$$. The remnants of the $$マリーメイア$$ army have been wiped out.」

348:t_031:7.en:
$$カレン$$
「Thank goodness... The Mars colonists are safe.」

348:t_031:8.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「First, let's rendezvous with them and exchange information.」

348:t_031:9.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...Those branded with the $$烙印$$ get their fates tossed about by spacequakes... huh...」

348:t_031:10.en:
$$万丈$$
($$アドヴェント#pilot$$ and $$アサキム・ドーウィン$$... And the $$クロノ$$ Reformists...)

348:t_032:1.en:
$$クルツ$$
「What a cold bastard! Show some panic for once!」

348:t_032:2.en:
$$宗介$$
「Is he saying he has complete control over his emotions...!」

348:t_032:3.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Ridiculous. Do you make a huge fuss about dying just because you tripped on a stone in the road?」

348:t_032:5.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Your existence is only that much, after all! In front of me and $$アン・アーレス$$!」

348:t_032:6.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Don't get cocky, $$バルビエル$$! Then I'll punch through your skull with that pebble!」
